$comment: Canonical, machine-readable owner-self-use runtime environment contract for OpsIQ. This is the single structured source of truth used by the env-consistency test (src/__tests__/deployment/owner-self-use-env-contract-consistency.test.ts). It lists variable NAMES and classifications only — it never contains secret VALUES. Derived by inspecting real code usage, not by guessing. Boot path: src/instrumentation.ts -> startup-orchestrator (no env gate); Prisma reads DATABASE_URL; NODE_ENV governs prod cookie security; NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL builds absolute links. Reconciled against .env.example, scripts/deployment-preflight.mjs, scripts/validate-deployment.ts.
generatedFor: PASS 46 — Deploy manifest + runtime environment readiness

required.name: NODE_ENV
required.why: Governs production cookie Secure/SameSite and security behavior. App defaults to development if unset, which is unsafe for a real deployment.

required.name: DATABASE_URL
required.why: Prisma runtime connection. Without it the app cannot read/write governed records.

required.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
required.why: Public origin used to build absolute links across owner/dashboard pages. Wrong value = broken links/redirects.
required.readAt: runtime + build (NEXT_PUBLIC_* is inlined at build time)
required.legacyAlias: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL (accepted by validate-deployment only; set NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL)

migrationOnly.name: MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL
migrationOnly.why: Used ONLY by the Prisma CLI for `migrate deploy` (advisory locks/DDL need a direct endpoint). Falls back to DATABASE_URL if unset (fine for local/single-endpoint Postgres).
migrationOnly.readAt: prisma CLI / CI migration gate (.github/workflows/migrate-production.yml uses PRODUCTION_DATABASE_URL secret)

optional.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
optional.why: Billing (canonical). Absent => billing disabled, never a boot failure (lazy client).

optional.name: STRIPE_API_KEY
optional.why: Legacy alias for STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (accepted only if canonical unset).

optional.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
optional.why: Billing webhook signature verification. Absent => webhooks rejected/disabled.

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
optional.why: Billing client key. Absent => no client-side Stripe.

optional.name: OPSIQ_DIAGNOSTIC_KEY
optional.why: Gates internal diagnostic/ops endpoints. Absent => those endpoints stay fail-closed (locked). Not needed for the owner journey.

optional.name: SENTRY_DSN
optional.why: Error tracking. Absent => no Sentry, app still boots.

optional.name: LOG_LEVEL
optional.why: Logging verbosity. Production should be info/warn (debug in prod is flagged by validate-deployment).

ciTestOnly.name: TEST_WITH_DB
ciTestOnly.why: Enables DB-backed vitest lanes. MUST NOT be set in production.

ciTestOnly.name: TEST_DATABASE_URL
ciTestOnly.why: Test database URL. MUST NOT be set in production.

ciTestOnly.name: DATABASE_URL_TEST
ciTestOnly.why: Alt test database URL. MUST NOT be set in production.

ciTestOnly.name: SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION
ciTestOnly.why: Local/CI convenience to skip validation. MUST NOT be set in production.

ciTestOnly.name: RUN_LIVE_AI
ciTestOnly.why: Enables live-AI test lanes. MUST NOT be set in production (owner self-use runs no external LLM).

ciTestOnly.name: LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_ATTEMPTS
ciTestOnly.why: CI-only override to raise the login rate-limit ceiling for serial e2e logins from one IP. Clamped >= production default (10); MUST NOT be used to weaken production.

phantomUnused.name: JWT_SECRET
phantomUnused.reality: That validator is imported ONLY by a test; it is NOT wired into src/instrumentation.ts, middleware.ts, or any route. JWT_SECRET is read nowhere on the boot/request path. Do NOT treat as required; do NOT add to production.

phantomUnused.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
phantomUnused.reality: Same as JWT_SECRET — dead validator, not wired into boot.

phantomUnused.name: AUTH_SECRET
phantomUnused.reality: getConfig()/isProduction()/isStaging()/isDevelopment() are used nowhere in runtime code. Auth is DB-backed session cookie (bcrypt, no NextAuth, no signing secret). Optional/forward-compat only.

phantomUnused.name: AUTH_URL
phantomUnused.declaredIn: src/lib/config.ts (getConfig, unused) + owner-pilot e2e workflow env
phantomUnused.reality: Not read at runtime. Set in CI e2e only.

phantomUnused.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
phantomUnused.reality: NextAuth is not used. Phantom; never required.

phantomUnused.name: NEXTAUTH_URL
phantomUnused.reality: NextAuth is not used. Phantom; never required.
